note: By-election of a councillor for Shankill Ward, 25 September 1936, to fill a casual vacancy. The register records the member as elected but gives no votes and does not say whether there was a poll. Register remarks: vice Col Wm Rowan deceased (9 Aug 1936); no votes shown.
